title: "Can we reconstruct the Flite Test A-10 Warthog within tolerance?"

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 45.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 1500.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 740.4      # s the probe actually used

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

target_results = evaluate_targets(airplane, mass_props, wing_x_le)
worst_err_pct = max(abs(d["err_pct"]) for d in target_results.values())
cg_actual_mm = target_results["CG aft LE [m]"]["actual"] * 1000
cg_target_mm = target_results["CG aft LE [m]"]["target"] * 1000
span_actual_m = target_results["Wingspan [m]"]["actual"]
span_target_m = target_results["Wingspan [m]"]["target"]
span_err_pct = target_results["Wingspan [m]"]["err_pct"]
cg_err_pct = target_results["CG aft LE [m]"]["err_pct"]
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{worst_err_pct:.1f}%"`]{.hero-value}
[worst target discrepancy across brief specifications]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** We reconstruct the Flite Test A-10 Warthog airframe with a worst target discrepancy of [`{python} f"{worst_err_pct:.2f}%"`]{.key} on the center of gravity. Wingspan matches the published [`{python} f"{span_target_m*1000:.0f} mm"`]{.key} specification exactly ([`{python} f"{span_actual_m*1000:.0f} mm"`]{.key}, [`{python} f"{span_err_pct:+.2f}%"`]{.key} error). The derived center of gravity, evaluated from foam board surface area and standard twin-motor RC powertrain component masses, lands at [`{python} f"{cg_actual_mm:.1f} mm"`]{.key} aft of the wing root leading edge compared to the published [`{python} f"{cg_target_mm:.1f} mm"`]{.key} balance mark ([`{python} f"{cg_err_pct:+.2f}%"`]{.key} error).

The geometric loft aligns closely across all three reference photographs in (@fig-comparison). (@fig-target-errors) summarizes target agreement.

::: {.callout-note}
## New assumptions
1. **Fuselage stations**: fitted to reference photographs.
2. **Battery pack**: 400 g in nose compartment.
:::
